info.description: Aalto University Course API. Please do not use, as it returns old data. Instead please use https://3scale.apps.ocp4.aalto.fi/docs/swagger/open_courses_sisu.
info.title: Aalto Open API (Deprecated)

get.summary: Return Aalto University active course realisations. Deprecated, please do not use

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: wild card search for code Example: Besc*

parameters.name: endTimeAfter
parameters.description: return all course units which ends after the specified time. Default is current date. Example: 2013-12-31

parameters.name: endTimeBefore
parameters.description: return all course units which ends before the specified time Example: 2014-12-31

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: filter by organization id Example: A802

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Searches from course code, name, teacher and summary. Supports multiple keywords. Example: Kandidaatti+seminaari+A801. Deprecated, please do not use

parameters.name: startTimeAfter
parameters.description: return all course units which starts after the specified time Example: 2013-12-31

parameters.name: startTimeBefore
parameters.description: return all course units which starts before the specified time Example: 2014-12-31

parameters.name: unitType
parameters.description: filter course units by type Example: course

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit the size of resultset Example: 200
